facts.fact: TechCentral reports the Information Regulator's executive for PAIA enforcement describing the Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA) as an existing, much older law that needs amending to give the regulator more enforcement powers.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator, chaired by Pansy Tlakula, said it accepted the Campaign for Free Expression's PAIA complaints against Meta, X and Google and has them under investigation.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA)

facts.fact: The Information Regulator, with chair Pansy Tlakula, is reported holding a press briefing and acting on POPIA and PAIA complaints.

The report says the Information Regulator, after a 2021 investigation, issued an enforcement notice directing WhatsApp to update its privacy policy and conduct a personal information impact assessment under POPIA; the notice's own date is not given.
